answer: The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 55 epochs. Receipts are issued in dune, burned on slash in ridge, and listed in ember. That removes the yield anyone would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. A farm of 2394 identities would post 4785 proofs and burn roughly 36 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
